title: Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology
title_original: 국립생태원의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Submission of Budget Requests for Contributions, Etc.)
(1) Where the National Institute of Ecology intends to request a contribution or subsidy from the State pursuant to Article 16 of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), it shall submit a budget request for contributions or subsidies (hereinafter referred to as “contributions, etc.”) to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment by May 31 of each year, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended on July 2, 2019; October 1, 2025>
1. A business plan for the following year;
2. A projected income statement and a projected statement of financial position for the following year;
3. Other documents necessary for the budget request.
(2) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment deems a budget request under paragraph (1) appropriate, the Minister shall prepare a draft budget reflecting its details and, when the budget for contributions, etc. is finalized, notify the National Institute of Ecology thereof. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 3 (Payment of Contributions, Etc.)
(1) To receive contributions, etc., the National Institute of Ecology shall submit an application for payment to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, accompanied by quarterly business plans and budget execution plans for the relevant year. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) Where the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment receives an application under paragraph (1) and deems the business plans and budget execution plans appropriate, the Minister shall pay contributions, etc. to the National Institute of Ecology. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 4 (Application for Approval of Borrowing of Funds)
To obtain approval for borrowing funds pursuant to Article 18 of the Act, the National Institute of Ecology shall submit an application for approval containing the following matters to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment, accompanied by a copy of the minutes of the meeting of the board of directors at which the borrowing of funds was decided: <Amended on July 2, 2019; October 1, 2025>
1. Reasons for borrowing and the amount to be borrowed;
2. Lender;
3. Terms of borrowing;
4. Method and deadline for repayment of the borrowed funds;
5. Other matters necessary for borrowing and repayment of funds.

Article 5 (Types of Profit-Making Businesses)
The National Institute of Ecology may conduct the following businesses as profit-making businesses pursuant to Article 20 (1) of the Act: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Admission to the National Institute of Ecology and viewing of exhibition halls, etc.;
2. Production and distribution of souvenirs, publications, etc. related to the National Institute of Ecology;
3. Distribution of animals and plants, etc. raised or cultivated at the National Institute of Ecology;
4. Dissemination of educational programs developed by the National Institute of Ecology;
5. Leasing of facilities of the National Institute of Ecology;
6. Advertising using facilities of the National Institute of Ecology;
7. Other businesses deemed necessary by the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment for the operation of the National Institute of Ecology.

Article 6 (Submission of Business Plans and Related Documents)
(1) Where the President of the National Institute of Ecology (hereinafter referred to as the "President") intends to obtain approval of a business plan and budget pursuant to the former part of Article 22 of the Act, the President shall submit the business plan and budget for the following year to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment by October 31 of each year. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The budget under paragraph (1) shall include general budget provisions, a projected statement of financial position, a projected income statement, and a funding plan, and shall be accompanied by documents necessary to clarify its contents. <Amended on July 2, 2019>
(3) Where the President intends to obtain approval of changes to a business plan and budget pursuant to the latter part of Article 22 of the Act, the President shall submit a document stating the details of and reasons for the changes to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 7 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Accounts)
Pursuant to Article 23 of the Act, the President shall submit a statement of settlement of revenues and expenditures, accompanied by a report on business performance for the relevant year and the following documents, to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment by the last day of February of the following year: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. Financial statements (including an audit opinion issued by a certified public accountant or an accounting corporation under Article 23 of the Certified Public Accountant Act) and their supporting documents;
2. Other documents necessary to clarify the details of the settlement of accounts.

Article 8 (Conducting Operational Evaluations)
(1) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall conduct an operational evaluation under Article 25(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an "operational evaluation" in this Article) every 3 years. <Amended on October 1, 2025>
(2) The detailed criteria for operational evaluations shall be as follows: <Amended on July 2, 2019>
1. Evaluation of management conditions: The degree of responsible management and operational efficiency, the appropriateness of budget, organizational, and human resources management, etc.;
2. Evaluation of the performance of projects to promote ecosystem research activities: The extent to which the research infrastructure has been expanded, the quality of project plans and results, etc.;
3. Evaluation of services to the public concerning ecosystems: The levels of customer satisfaction and service impact perceived by the public, achievements in improving services, etc.
(3) The Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment shall prepare evaluation guidelines specifying the basic direction, scope, schedule, and other matters concerning an operational evaluation and notify the National Institute of Ecology of such guidelines no later than 3 months before the date of the operational evaluation. <Amended on October 1, 2025>

Article 9 (Requests for Secondment of Public Officials and Other Personnel)
(1) Where the President intends to request the secondment of personnel pursuant to Article 28(1) of the Act, the President shall submit a request for secondment specifying the following matters to the Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment: <Amended on October 1, 2025>
1. The reasons for requesting the secondment;
2. The period of secondment;
3. The number of personnel to be seconded;
4. The fields of expertise and qualifications required of the personnel to be seconded.
(2) A person seconded to the National Institute of Ecology shall comply with the service regulations and other rules prescribed by the President during the period of secondment.
(3) Where allowances are to be paid to persons seconded pursuant to paragraph (1), the criteria for payment shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation of the National Institute of Ecology: Provided, That the criteria for payment of allowances to seconded public officials shall not exceed the criteria prescribed by the Minister of the Interior and Safety or the Minister of Personnel Management pursuant to Article 41(8) of the Decree on the Appointment of Public Officials and Article 27-2(6) of the Decree on the Appointment of Local Public Officials. <Amended on November 19, 2014; July 26, 2017>

Article 10 (Criteria for Imposing Administrative Fines)
The criteria for imposing administrative fines under Article 34(1) of the Act shall be as specified in the Annex.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 24718, September 9, 2013>

This Decree shall enter into force on September 13, 2013.

ADDENDA (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Government Administration and Home Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 25751, November 19, 2014>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 5 of these Addenda, the portions amending Presidential Decrees that were promulgated before this Decree enters into force but have not yet entered into force shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (321) Omitted.
(322) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology is partially amended as follows:
In the proviso to Article 9 (3), "Minister of Security and Public Administration" is replaced with "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs or Minister of Personnel Management".
(323) through (418) Omitted.

ADDENDA (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 28211, July 26, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 8 of these Addenda, the portions amending Presidential Decrees that were promulgated before this Decree enters into force but have not yet entered into force shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 7 Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (245) Omitted.
(246) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology is partially amended as follows:
In the proviso to Article 9 (3), "Minister of Government Administration and Home Affairs" is replaced with "Minister of the Interior and Safety".
(247) through (388) Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree Partially Amending 210 Statutes to Simplify Difficult Legal Terminology) <Presidential Decree No. 29950, July 2, 2019>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

ADDENDA (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 35804, October 1, 2025>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, among Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 6 of these Addenda, the portions amending Presidential Decrees that were promulgated before this Decree enters into force but have not yet entered into force shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (5) Omitted.
(6) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Institute of Ecology is partially amended as follows:
In the introductory part of Article 2 (1), paragraph (2) of that Article, Article 3 (1) and (2), the introductory part of Article 4, Article 5, subparagraph 7, Article 6 (1) and (3), the introductory part of Article 7, Article 8 (1) and (3), and the introductory part of Article 9 (1), "Minister of Environment" is replaced with "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment", respectively.
(7) through (80) Omitted.
